frozen_input.selection: 120s contiguous; event contains <=2 with >=30s before/after; rank minimum count, longest low duration, earliest time; disjoint control min>2, minimum edge-set churn then count variation
frozen_input.evaluation: Per-GS rolling mean high rate >=0.5; pooled complete windows at 5s stride. Longest instantaneous high under-rate across GS. Volume is delivered Gbit. Switch counts changes of association after initial selection, including disconnect/reconnect.
frozen_input.model: Piecewise constant 5s service; no queue/carryover; expired link gives zero until recovery or scheduled reselection; initial association at window start. Raw means no synthetic tightening/protection, not zero extra loss. Throughput policy retains existing throughput-first/QoS-second allocator; baselines use QoS-first allocator.

emission.assumptions: Post-WRC-19 non-GSO fixed earth station, clear-sky rule, no uplink power control. Antenna gain and integrated suppression are synthetic. Port reference absorbs feeder losses.

information: Saved future links; ideal-information oracle, not operational forecast.
eligibility: Available at period start; cannot select a satellite that only appears later.

propagation.elevation: Frozen geometric ground elevation used as apparent elevation
